title: Economics Nobel laureates, 1969–2026
description: Every winner of the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel — the prize usually called the economics Nobel — from the first award in 1969 to the 2026 award. For each laureate: the official citation, their share of the prize, where they worked when it was awarded, and where and when they were born. A second table gives each year's prize money in Swedish kronor.

sources.title: Nobel Prize API v2.1 — economics laureates
Nobel Prize API v2.1 — economics prizes

licenses.name: CC0 1.0 (as stated in the Nobel Prize API terms of use)

update_frequency: Annual — the prize is announced each October

fields.name: award_year
fields.description: The year the prize was awarded (a calendar year).

fields.name: order_within_year
fields.description: The order the Nobel Foundation lists that year's laureates in: 1, 2 or 3. Not a ranking.

fields.name: laureate_id
fields.description: The Nobel Foundation's own identifier for the person. Stable across its API and website.

fields.name: known_name
fields.description: The name the person is usually known by, as the source gives it.

fields.name: full_name
fields.description: The fuller form of the name, as the source gives it. Often the same as known_name.

fields.name: gender
fields.description: As recorded by the source: 'male' or 'female'.

fields.name: birth_year
fields.description: Year of birth (a calendar year).

fields.name: birth_date
fields.description: Date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty where the source records only the year.

fields.name: birth_city
fields.description: City of birth, as named by the source. Empty where it is not recorded.

fields.name: birth_country
fields.description: Country of birth as it was named at the time of birth — for example 'Russian Empire'. Empty where not recorded.

fields.name: birth_country_now
fields.description: The present-day country that the place of birth lies in — for example 'Belarus'. Use this column, not birth_country, to count laureates by today's countries.

fields.name: death_date
fields.description: Date of death, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty if the laureate is living (as of the retrieval date).

fields.name: prize_share
fields.description: The laureate's share of that year's prize, as a fraction written by the source: '1', '1/2', '1/3' or '1/4'. A share of the money, not a ranking of the work.

fields.name: motivation
fields.description: The official English citation for the award, word for word. Laureates who share a year sometimes have different citations.

fields.name: affiliation_at_award
fields.description: The institution or institutions the laureate was at when awarded, as listed by the source. Several are separated by '; '. Empty where the source lists none.

fields.name: affiliation_country_at_award
fields.description: The country of each institution in affiliation_at_award, in the same order, separated by '; '.

fields.name: nobel_facts_url
fields.description: Web address of the laureate's facts page for this prize on nobelprize.org.

fields.name: wikipedia_url
fields.description: Web address of the laureate's English Wikipedia article, as linked by the source.

fields.name: award_year
fields.description: The year the prize was awarded (a calendar year).

fields.name: date_awarded
fields.description: The date the prize was announced, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: laureate_count
fields.description: How many people shared the prize that year: 1, 2 or 3.

fields.name: prize_amount_sek
fields.description: The total prize money for that year, in Swedish kronor (SEK), nominal — the amount in that year's money, not adjusted for inflation. Shared between that year's laureates according to prize_share.
